messages:
rachel: Thalia POC showing TTFT tail spikes during load test. median ~270ms but some first-token spikes 2-3.5s when ~90 concurrent connections. Gateway logs show TLS handshake timeouts.

rachel: pasted snippet:
```n2026-03-26T10:12:01Z TLS handshake timeout from 10.9.4.7
2026-03-26T10:12:02Z 502 upstream reset id=th-77
```

omar: likely connection churn + batching window amplifying queueing. quick checks: do they use keepalive/pools? get api_key to pull route metrics.

lucy: api_key thalia-poc-88. they said "managed gateway" so connections are short-lived.

omar: quick mitigation: push route override to reduce batch_window, cap batch size, enable small prefix_kv_cache, and bump edge keepalive for that key. Command:
```nredwood routes update --api-key=thalia-poc-88 --set batch_window_ms=2 --set max_batch_size=12 --set prefix_kv_cache.enabled=true --set prefix_kv_cache.ttl=300 --set edge.keepalive=120s
```

ops-bot: config-change 2026-03-26T10:23:11 applied: route_override(thalia-poc-88) batch_window_ms=2 max_batch_size=12 prefix_kv_cache.enabled=true ttl=300 edge.keepalive=120s.

rachel: customer enabled keepalive on their side. after 15m: median ~300ms, 95p dropped from ~3.4s -> ~650ms. a couple ~1s outliers remain but much better for the demo.

omar: follow-ups: solutions to provide 6-prompt prefill to warm KV, sales to offer 3-hour demo burst credit if they want zero-risk for demo peak.

rachel: confirmed demo window and will accept burst credit. closing after demo. :white_check_mark:
